abstract: Motivated by the substantial growth and upfront investments of venture capital (VC)-backed firms observed in administrative US Census data, this study develops a life-cycle firm dynamics model. In the model, startups choose the source of financing from VC, angel investors, or banks, depending on their growth potential, and invest in innovation. The calibrated model explains the life-cycle dynamics of firms with different sources of financing and suggests that venture capitalists' managerial advice accounts for around 22% of the growth in VC-backed firms. A counterfactual economy without VC financing would experience an aggregate consumption loss of around 0.46%.
abstract_zh: 受美国行政人口普查数据中风险投资（VC）支持企业显著增长及前期投资的启发，本研究构建了一个企业生命周期动态模型。在该模型中，初创企业根据其增长潜力，从风险投资、天使投资人或银行中选择融资来源，并进行创新投资。校准后的模型解释了不同融资来源企业的生命周期动态，并表明风险投资家的管理建议约占风险投资支持企业增长的22%。一个没有风险投资融资的反事实经济将遭受约0.46%的总消费损失。
title: Dynamics of High‐Growth Young Firms and the Role of Venture Capitalists
title_zh: 高增长年轻企业的动态与风险投资家的作用

abstract: We consider the problem of time-varying high quantile estimation for a general class of nonstationary tail dependent time series. Unlike the conventional quantile analysis in which the quantile level is typically assumed to be fixed, the current high quantile setting requires the quantile level to grow with the sample size to capture the tail phenomenon. In addition, for nonstationary time series data, the underlying data generating mechanism is expected to change over time, and as a result the associated time-varying high quantile can no longer be treated as a constant parameter making existing results not directly applicable. In this article, we model the underlying time-varying high quantile as a nonparametric function of time to avoid any parametric misspecification, and we establish the consistency and central limit theorem of nonparametric high quantile estimators for a general class of nonstationary tail dependent time series. It can be seen from our limit theorems that the asymptotic behavior of nonparametric high quantile estimators can be affected by both the double asymptotic scheme caused by the growing quantile level and the serial tail dependence in time series data. Numerical results are provided to illustrate the developed results, and an extension to time-varying high quantile regression models is also discussed.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了一类广泛非平稳尾部相依时间序列中时变高分为点估计的问题。与通常假设分位水平固定的传统分位分析不同，当前高分为设定要求分位水平随样本量增长以捕捉尾部现象。此外，对于非平稳时间序列数据，其背后的数据生成机制预期随时间变化，因此相关的时变高分为点不能再被视为常数参数，这使得现有结果无法直接适用。在本文中，我们将潜在的时变高分为点建模为时间的非参数函数，以避免任何参数误设，并针对一类广泛的非平稳尾部相依时间序列，建立了非参数高分为点估计量的一致性及中心极限定理。从我们的极限定理可以看出，非参数高分为点估计量的渐近行为可能同时受到由增长的分位水平引起的双重渐近方案以及时间序列数据中序列尾部相依性的影响。文中提供了数值结果以说明所发展的理论，并进一步讨论了向时变高分为回归模型的扩展。
title: Time-Varying High Quantile Estimation for Nonstationary Tail Dependent Time Series
title_zh: 非平稳尾部相依时间序列的时变高分位数估计

abstract: We propose a novel methodology for discovering the presence of relationships realized as binary time series between variables in high dimension. To make it visually intuitive, we regard the existence of a relationship as an edge connection, and call a collection of such edges a network. Our objective is thus rephrased as uncovering the network by selecting relevant edges, referred to as the network exploration. Our methodology is based on multiple testing for the presence or absence of each edge, designed to ensure statistical reproducibility via controlling the false discovery rate (FDR). In particular, we carefully construct p-variables, and apply the Benjamini-Hochberg (BH) procedure. We show that the BH with our p-variables controls the FDR under arbitrary dependence structure with any sample size and dimension, and has asymptotic power one under mild conditions. The validity is also confirmed by simulations and a real data example.
abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种新颖的方法论，用于在高维变量间发现以二元时间序列形式实现的关系存在性。为使视觉直观，我们将关系的存在视为边连接，并将此类边的集合称为网络。因此，我们的目标被重新表述为通过选择相关边来揭示网络，即网络探索。我们的方法论基于对每条边存在与否的多重检验，旨在通过控制错误发现率（FDR）确保统计可重复性。特别地，我们精心构造p变量，并应用Benjamini-Hochberg（BH）程序。我们证明，在任意依赖结构下，无论样本量和维度如何，我们的p变量配合BH程序都能控制FDR，并在温和条件下具有渐近功效为1。其有效性也通过模拟实验和实际数据示例得到验证。
title: Robust Reproducible Network Exploration
title_zh: 稳健可复现的网络探索

abstract: Quantile vector autoregression (QVAR) models offer enhanced capabilities over vector autoregression (VAR) models in analyzing asymmetric interactions within multiple time series and are widely used in many areas, including finance and economics. However, in scenarios involving high-dimensional data where the number of time series N exceeds the length of the time series T, both parameter estimation and the theoretical establishment present significant challenges. Notably, existing research has not yet explored these challenges with the framework of QVAR models. To handle this problem, we propose a novel high-dimensional QVAR model that incorporates influencers and communities, which assumes that variables within distinct communities have shared dependency structures and are influenced by the same set of variables, called influencers. We develop an estimation procedure based on the alternating minimization algorithm and the convolution-smoothed approach. The local consistency results for the estimated parameters are established in high-dimensional settings with sub-Weibull innovations. Numerical studies illustrate that the proposed model performs well in finite samples. The proposed model is applied to identify the most influential macroeconomic variables in the United States across business cycles and construct a dynamic quantile network with influencers and communities for volatility spillover effects of global stock markets.
abstract_zh: 分位数向量自回归（QVAR）模型相较于向量自回归（VAR）模型，在分析多元时间序列中的非对称交互作用方面具有更强的能力，并广泛应用于金融和经济学等多个领域。然而，在高维数据场景下，当时间序列数量N超过时间序列长度T时，参数估计和理论构建均面临显著挑战。值得注意的是，现有研究尚未在QVAR模型框架内探讨这些挑战。为解决这一问题，我们提出了一种新颖的高维QVAR模型，该模型纳入影响者与社群结构，假设不同社群内的变量具有共享的依赖结构，并受同一组变量（称为影响者）的影响。我们开发了一种基于交替最小化算法和卷积平滑方法的估计程序。在高维设置下，针对次Weibull创新项，我们建立了估计参数的局部一致性结果。数值研究表明，所提出的模型在有限样本中表现良好。该模型被应用于识别美国商业周期中最具影响力的宏观经济变量，并构建一个包含影响者与社群的动态分位数网络，以分析全球股票市场的波动溢出效应。
title: High-Dimensional Quantile Vector Autoregression with Influencers and Communities
title_zh: 高维分位数向量自回归：影响者与社区结构

abstract: We develop a model that shows how foreign reserve management decisions can adversely affect U.S. money market liquidity. Consistent with the March 2020 dash-for-cash, our model suggests that as export-price volatility increases, a foreign central bank that pegs its exchange rate shifts reserves from relatively illiquid Treasuries to the Fed’s reverse repo facility. Over the relevant horizon, this precautionary behavior drains liquidity from U.S. money markets and raises repo spreads. These predictions provide a credible channel to identify the effect of foreign central bank demand for dollar liquidity on repo spreads, exploiting the characteristics of commodity exporters with pegged exchange rates. Empirical evidence supports the model’s predictions: precautionary sales by these central banks lead to a statistically and economically significant widening of repo spreads, accompanied by a drawdown in Treasury balances. These results underscore how the Fed’s foreign-repo facilities mitigate global dollar-funding stress and protect U.S. short-term funding markets.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个模型，展示外汇储备管理决策如何对美元货币市场流动性产生不利影响。与2020年3月的“现金争夺”现象一致，我们的模型表明，随着出口价格波动性增加，实行汇率盯住制度的外国央行会将其储备从相对缺乏流动性的美国国债转向美联储的逆回购工具。在相关时间范围内，这种预防性行为会抽干美国货币市场的流动性，并推高回购利差。这些预测提供了一个可信的渠道，用以识别外国央行对美元流动性需求对回购利差的影响，利用的是实行盯住汇率制的商品出口国的特征。实证证据支持模型的预测：这些央行的预防性抛售导致回购利差在统计和经济意义上显著扩大，同时伴随美国国债余额的减少。这些结果强调了美联储的外国回购便利如何缓解全球美元融资压力，并保护美国短期融资市场。
title: Central banker to the world: Foreign reserve management and U.S. money market liquidity
title_zh: 全球央行：外汇储备管理与美国货币市场流动性

abstract: This paper empirically examines the use of different survey expectations in the U.S. Phillips curve. I find that between the Michigan Surveys of Consumers’ (MSC) and Survey of Professional Forecasters’ (SPF) short‐ and long‐term forecasts, short‐term forecasts from the MSC are the best measure of inflation expectations for use in the Phillips curve. These results are robust to specifications of the Phillips curve with different measures of inflation, labor market slack, and sample periods. Furthermore, I find that conditional forecasts of inflation using short‐term MSC expectations lead to the greatest improvement in out‐of‐sample Root Mean Square Error (RMSE) relative to other expectations.
abstract_zh: 本文实证检验了美国菲利普斯曲线中不同调查预期的使用情况。我发现，在密歇根消费者调查（MSC）与专业预测者调查（SPF）的短期和长期预测中，MSC的短期预测是菲利普斯曲线中衡量通胀预期的最佳指标。这些结果对于采用不同通胀衡量指标、劳动力市场松弛度及样本期的菲利普斯曲线设定均保持稳健。此外，我发现，使用MSC短期预期的通胀条件预测，相对于其他预期，在样本外均方根误差（RMSE）方面带来了最大改善。
journal: Journal of Money, Credit and Banking
title: Survey Expectations in the U.S. Phillips Curve
title_zh: 美国菲利普斯曲线中的调查预期

abstract: ABSTRACT Policies that target a single aspect of agents' motivation may lead to their diminished efforts in other areas. This paper examines the effect of the European Union's flight delay compensation policy on flight on‐time performance by exploiting a unique policy variation in a difference‐in‐differences framework. The policy requires airlines to offer cash compensation to passengers for delays lasting more than 3 h. I find that, while the policy decreases the proportion of delays exceeding 180 min by 0.3 percentage points (20 percent), it also reduces the proportion of delays less than 15 min by 3.6 percentage points (5 percent). This effect spillovers to routes without the policy variation. Evidence suggests that the results are related to airlines' delay management practices. I also show that the results hold under a variety of robustness checks, and alternative explanations are ruled out. This paper provides insights into airlines' strategic responses to regulatory incentives and informs the design of related transportation policies and quality regulation.
abstract_zh: 摘要 针对个体动机单一方面的政策可能导致其在其他领域努力减少。本文利用差异中的差异框架中的独特政策变异，考察了欧盟航班延误补偿政策对航班准点表现的影响。该政策要求航空公司对延误超过3小时的乘客提供现金补偿。我发现，尽管该政策将超过180分钟的延误比例降低了0.3个百分点（20%），但也将少于15分钟的延误比例降低了3.6个百分点（5%）。这种效应溢出至无政策变异的航线。证据表明，这些结果与航空公司的延误管理实践相关。我还表明，在多种稳健性检验下结果依然成立，并排除了其他替代解释。本文为航空公司对监管激励的战略性回应提供了见解，并为相关交通政策及质量监管的设计提供参考。
title: Quality Regulation and Unexpected Gaming: Evidence From Mandating Flight Delay Compensation
title_zh: 质量监管与意外博弈：基于航班延误强制补偿的证据

abstract: • Artefactual field experiment can precisely calibrate and vary ambiguous environment. • Ambiguity is an important factor limiting technology adoption under index insurance. • Technology take-up rates depend on the degree of ambiguity. This paper investigates the effect of ambiguity on technology adoption under index insurance. I conduct an artefactual field experiment with Ghanaian cocoa farmers. Experimental subjects had an option to invest in a package of fertilizer bundled with index insurance. The returns depended both on the subjects’ investment choices and on a stochastic weather realization. The key ingredient of the study was whether the exact probability of bad weather was known or not. This probability was ambiguous in the experimental treatments, and the degree of this ambiguity varied across treatments. A large negative effect on fertilizer investments was found in treatments with either small or large ambiguity. The effect of large ambiguity was also found to be significantly stronger, suggesting that technologies with which farmers are relatively more experienced are more likely to be adopted under index insurance schemes. I provide new evidence that ambiguity may be a significant factor limiting the effectiveness of index insurance in promoting agricultural innovation. The overall findings are complementary to related recent randomized controlled trials, since it is effectively impossible to precisely calibrate and vary the level of ambiguity using the latter methodology.
abstract_zh: 人工实地实验能够精确校准并变化模糊环境。模糊性是限制指数保险下技术采纳的重要因素。技术采纳率取决于模糊程度。本文研究了指数保险下模糊性对技术采纳的影响。我针对加纳可可种植户开展了一项人工实地实验。实验对象可选择投资于化肥与指数保险捆绑的组合。收益既取决于受试者的投资选择，也取决于随机的天气实现情况。研究的关键要素在于坏天气的确切概率是否已知。在实验处理中，该概率是模糊的，且模糊程度在不同处理间有所变化。在模糊程度较小或较大的处理中，均发现对化肥投资有显著的负面影响。同时，较大模糊性的影响显著更强，这表明农民相对更有经验的技术更可能在指数保险计划下被采纳。我提供了新证据，表明模糊性可能是限制指数保险促进农业创新有效性的重要因素。总体发现与近期相关的随机对照试验相辅相成，因为使用后一种方法实际上无法精确校准和变化模糊水平。
title: Ambiguity and technology adoption under index insurance: Experimental evidence
title_zh: 指数保险下的模糊性与技术采纳：实验证据

abstract: In January 2021, a group of stocks listed on U.S. stock exchanges experienced sudden price increases, which, coupled with high short interest, led to short squeezes. We find that discussions on social media fueled the association between retail trading and subsequent stock returns. Options market activity and securities lending constraints also played a central role. Using unique data from social media platforms, we provide a comprehensive account of these short squeezes. We find that they significantly impeded market quality for the stocks at issue and their competitors. Thus, the interplay between social media and retail traders may have adverse consequences for market quality and efficiency. This paper was accepted by Will Cong, finance. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.02887 .
abstract_zh: 2021年1月，一批在美国证券交易所上市的股票突然出现价格飙升，加之高空头兴趣，导致了轧空。我们发现，社交媒体上的讨论助推了散户交易与随后股票收益之间的关联。期权市场活动和证券借贷约束也发挥了核心作用。利用社交媒体平台的独特数据，我们全面阐述了这些轧空事件。我们发现，这些轧空显著损害了涉事股票及其竞争对手的市场质量。因此，社交媒体与散户交易者之间的相互作用可能对市场质量和效率产生不利后果。本文由金融领域编辑Will Cong接收。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在 https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.02887 获取。
publisher: Institute for Operations Research and the Management Sciences (INFORMS)
title: Squeezing Shorts Through Social Media Platforms
title_zh: 通过社交媒体平台挤压空头
